concept-infographic.name: Concept infographic
concept-infographic.description: Turn structured ideas into a clear visual explanation.
concept-infographic.placeholder: Explain the topic, audience, facts, modules, and relationships.

product-environment-edit.name: Product scene edit
product-environment-edit.description: Keep the product fixed while changing its environment.
product-environment-edit.placeholder: Describe the new setting, props, lighting, and preserved details.

product-exploded-view.name: Exploded product view
product-exploded-view.description: Show components and assembly order on one clean axis.
product-exploded-view.placeholder: Describe the product, components, materials, and sequence.

character-turnaround.name: Character turnaround
character-turnaround.description: Generate consistent front, side, and back views.
character-turnaround.placeholder: Describe identity anchors, clothing, equipment, and palette.

naturalist-field-guide.name: Field guide spread
naturalist-field-guide.description: Create an illustrated specimen page with precise callouts.
naturalist-field-guide.placeholder: Describe the specimen, detail views, facts, and page structure.

exact-type-poster.name: Editable type poster
exact-type-poster.description: Create a poster background with a protected headline zone.
exact-type-poster.placeholder: Describe the subject, mood, palette, composition, and headline placement.

ui-concept.name: UI concept
ui-concept.description: Generate a polished app, web, dashboard, or kiosk concept.
ui-concept.placeholder: Name the platform, purpose, hierarchy, components, and states.

seamless-pattern.name: Seamless pattern
seamless-pattern.description: Create a repeat-ready tile with checked edge continuity.
seamless-pattern.placeholder: Describe motifs, repeat logic, palette, scale, and density.

clean-object-removal.name: Clean object removal
clean-object-removal.description: Remove one object and reconstruct the retained background.
clean-object-removal.placeholder: Name what to remove and describe the retained texture and light.

portrait-outpaint.name: Portrait outpaint
portrait-outpaint.description: Extend a portrait while preserving identity and the original crop.
portrait-outpaint.placeholder: Describe the extension direction, scene, and preserved details.

backlight-rescue.name: Backlight rescue
backlight-rescue.description: Recover a dark subject without destroying the background.
backlight-rescue.placeholder: Describe the face lift, skin finish, background control, and color mood.

whiteboard-sketch-visual.name: Board sketch to visual
whiteboard-sketch-visual.description: Turn selected Board structure into a polished visual asset.
whiteboard-sketch-visual.placeholder: Describe the audience, visual style, hierarchy, and desired finish.
